_comment: Only applied to new authored GF0025-2021 band 7-9; legacy records are preserved. Sentence-specific gloss/token_pinyin in YAML take precedence.

gloss.项: classifier for projects, studies and matters
gloss.将: to take (introducing the object before a verb)
gloss.抄送: to send a copy to; to copy in
gloss.懊悔: to feel remorse; to regret deeply
gloss.场: classifier for events, matches and performances
gloss.送到: to deliver to; to bring to
gloss.怀着: to harbor; to hold (an ambition or feeling)
gloss.林间: among the trees; in the woods
gloss.次: classifier for occurrences or repetitions; time
gloss.家: home; family; classifier for households or businesses
gloss.个: general classifier for people and things
gloss.台: classifier for machines, appliances and vehicles
gloss.本: this; classifier for books and volumes
gloss.套: classifier for sets, suits or apartments
gloss.座: classifier for buildings, bridges, mountains and other large fixed structures
gloss.道: classifier for questions, dishes, streaks and other long narrow things
gloss.部: classifier for films, books and other works
gloss.遍: classifier for repetitions of a complete action; time
gloss.架: classifier for airplanes, machines or fights; frame
gloss.连: even (used with 都 or 也)
gloss.让: to let; to allow; to cause someone to do something
gloss.成: to become; into (as a result of an action)
gloss.一番: one fold (翻了一番 = to have doubled)
